name: bluetab
description: Find saved tabs, review tab groups and projects, and capture Brain Dump notes and reminders in Bluetab.

interface.longDescription:
Bluetab connects ChatGPT to the tab groups, projects, Brain Dump notes and reminders you keep in the Bluetab browser extension.

Ask for a page you saved last week, get a summary of what is in a group, turn a conversation into a new tab group, jot down a thought, or set a reminder. Reads come from the latest snapshot the extension uploads; changes are queued and applied the next time Bluetab is open in your browser.

Works with the Bluetab Chrome extension and your supertry.net account, with AI apps (MCP) turned on in Bluetab settings. You choose on the sign-in screen whether ChatGPT may make changes, and you can disconnect it at any time. Bluetab cannot delete anything through ChatGPT.
capabilities: Read and add Brain Dump notes
defaultPrompt: Find the tabs I saved about Lisbon.
What is in my Reading Queue group?
Add a Brain Dump note: pack the camera charger for Lisbon.

positive.prompt: Find the tabs I saved about Lisbon.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the two Lisbon tabs (Wikipedia and Wikivoyage) from the Weekend Trip group with their URLs.

positive.prompt: Which tab groups do I have in Bluetab?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Design References, Weekend Trip and Reading Queue with their tab counts.

positive.prompt: What is in my Reading Queue group?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Chrome for Developers Blog, MDN Blog and web.dev Blog tabs with their URLs.

positive.prompt: Add a Brain Dump note: pack the camera charger for Lisbon.
positive.expected_behavior: Queues the note and says it will appear in Bluetab the next time the extension is open.

positive.prompt: Save a Bluetab group called Accessibility with https://www.w3.org/WAI/ and https://webaim.org/.
positive.expected_behavior: Queues a new group named Accessibility with the two tabs and says it is queued.

negative.description: Live browser control is not supported
negative.prompt: Close all the tabs that are open in my browser right now.
Book me a flight to Lisbon.

review.commerce_description: Bluetab does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search saved tabs, read groups, projects and Brain Dump notes, and queue new groups, notes and reminders.

tr-TR.subtitle: Kayıtlı sekmeleriniz sohbette
tr-TR.description: Bluetab, ChatGPT'yi Bluetab tarayıcı eklentisinde tuttuğunuz sekme gruplarına, projelere, Brain Dump notlarına ve hatırlatıcılara bağlar. Kaydettiğiniz bir sayfayı bulun, bir grubu özetletin, yeni bir grup kaydedin veya not alın. Değişiklikler Bluetab tarayıcınızda açıkken uygulanır. Bluetab eklentisi ve supertry.net hesabınızla çalışır.

es-ES.subtitle: Tus pestañas guardadas
es-ES.description: Bluetab conecta ChatGPT con los grupos de pestañas, proyectos, notas de Brain Dump y recordatorios que guardas en la extensión Bluetab. Encuentra una página guardada, resume un grupo, guarda un grupo nuevo o toma una nota. Los cambios se aplican cuando Bluetab está abierto en tu navegador. Funciona con la extensión Bluetab y tu cuenta de supertry.net.

pt-BR.subtitle: Suas abas salvas no chat
pt-BR.description: O Bluetab conecta o ChatGPT aos grupos de abas, projetos, notas do Brain Dump e lembretes que você mantém na extensão Bluetab. Encontre uma página salva, resuma um grupo, salve um grupo novo ou anote uma ideia. As mudanças são aplicadas quando o Bluetab está aberto no navegador. Funciona com a extensão Bluetab e sua conta supertry.net.
